evidence.reason: After edit, calls metering.evaluate(0, 0.1, "monthly") instead of passing the units argument, so the function no longer computes a charge based on its input; test asserts subscriptionCharge(40) > 0.

After edit, adds `if (units === 0) return 0;` and introduces `if (u< 0)` referencing an undefined identifier `u`, which is a merge-only type/runtime error not covered by the excluded rules and breaks the negative-units RangeError contract.

Tests assert evaluate(20,...) > 0, usageQuote(30,...).amount > 0, historySize() > 0, and subscriptionCharge(40) > 0; the merged behavior of zero-unit evaluation and early zero return violates these jointly relied-on expectations.

result.userExplanation: 两处改动合并后，subscriptionCharge 不再传入实际 units 且 usageCharge 对 0 提前返回，导致测试所依赖的正数计费与负数抛错行为被破坏。
result.suggestedAction: 请修改 src/subscription.ts#subscriptionCharge，恢复将 units 传入 metering.evaluate（如 metering.evaluate(units, 0.1, "monthly")）并保留 metering.initialize()；同时修改 src/metering.ts#usageCharge，删除 `if (units === 0) return 0;` 并将 `if (u< 0)` 修正为 `if (units < 0)`。
